events.text:
Both symptoms have confirmed code root causes:

1. A-100 inflated stock (>100): `reserve()` in `inventory_api/app.py:77-83` has no `qty <= 0` guard, so `POST /reservations {qty:-15}` returns 201 and `STOCK -= qty` raises available 90→105 (log r-103). Proven by live 201 repro + `test_negative_qty_rejected` failing.

2. C-300 oversell (5 reserved vs 3): `cancel()` in `inventory_api/app.py:91-97` never checks `status=="cancelled"`, so second `DELETE /reservations/3` returns 200 and re-adds stock 3→5 (logs r-106/r-107), enabling the qty-5 reservation (r-109). Proven by `test_double_cancel_does_not_inflate` failing (second cancel 200).

CI is green because no existing test covers negative qty or double-cancel. Regression tests in `tests/test_regression_inventory_defects.py` fail as required.
Fixing both confirmed defects with minimal patches.
